summary.text: You may use MediSave for your own or approved dependants’ healthcare expenses even after declaring bankruptcy.

details.heading: Who can use it
details.body: You may use MediSave for your own healthcare expenses, or for approved dependants. Approved dependants include your spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings.

example_phrasings: As a bankrupt, can I still use my MediSave?
Can I use MediSave after bankruptcy?
Does bankruptcy stop me using MediSave?

sources.page_title: As a bankrupt, can I still use my MediSave?

quotes.text: You may use your MediSave to pay for your own or your approved dependants' healthcare expenses even if you have declared bankruptcy.
Approved dependants refer to your spouse, children, parents, grandparents and siblings.
